title: DGGI Probes ₹1 Lakh Cr China-Linked Gaming Transactions
summary: The Directorate General of GST Intelligence (DGGI) conducted searches across Vijayawada and Hyderabad’s Banjara Hills as part of an investigation…
llm_summary: The Directorate General of GST Intelligence (DGGI) has raided premises in Vijayawada and Hyderabad’s Banjara Hills, uncovering gaming‑related transactions worth about ₹1 lakh crore that appear to be linked to China. The probe suggests large-scale cross‑border money flows through Indian online‑gaming platforms, prompting regulators to tighten scrutiny of the sector’s financial operations.
